proposed_capability: Stop doctrine validator requiring GitHub Actions workflow as a mandatory quality owner. Require the independently executable local acceptance manifest, runner, tests and runbook instead; when legacy workflow remains, require parity via focused test; after retirement, preserve 49-check floor with focused regression.
player_save_control_impact: No user saves, peripherals, Windows settings, Entire configuration or GitHub Actions workflow are modified.
expected_outcome: Standalone BetterInstincts doctrine no longer requires .github/workflows/ci.yml for passing after retirement; requires local-quality contract, runner and tests, with negative tests ensuring missing or diluted canonical owner is refused.
negative_tests: Missing local acceptance manifest fails doctrine
Removed legacy workflow does not fail doctrine after local gate is installed
Unmodified existing doctrine and gameplay invariants remain enforced
rollback_path: Revert isolated code change without changing current GitHub Actions file.
unresolved_unknowns: Operator local host integration and physical sandbox proof remain open
Formal GitHub Actions retirement is later authorization/proof gated
